title: The rare-earth deadline moved. Only two months.

lines.text: November 10 is no longer the date. January 10 is.
lines.say: November tenth is no longer the date. January tenth is.

lines.text: Four weeks before Chinese New Year.
lines.say: Four weeks before Chinese New Year.

lines.text: I'm Leo. I trade components in Shenzhen.
lines.say: I'm Leo. I trade components in Shenzhen.

lines.text: On September 28, Beijing confirmed the US–China truce now runs to January 10.
lines.say: On September twenty-eighth, Beijing confirmed the truce now runs to January tenth.

visual.kicker: WHAT IT PAUSES. WHAT IT DOESN'T.

active.label: NEVER PAUSED · APR 2025 RULES
active.note: EXPORT LICENSE · UP TO 45 WORKING DAYS

lines.text: That truce is what paused China's October 2025 rare-earth rules.
lines.say: That truce is what paused China's October twenty twenty-five rare-earth rules.

lines.text: The April rules never paused: seven rare earths still need a license. Up to 45 working days.
lines.say: But the April rules never paused. Seven rare earths still need a license. Up to forty-five working days.

visual.kicker: WHERE THEY SIT IN YOUR BOM
visual.note: WHERE THEY'RE USED · NOT A SHORTAGE CLAIM

lines.text: Yttrium is the most common rare-earth dopant in X7R MLCCs.
lines.say: Yttrium is the most common rare-earth dopant in X-seven-R M-L-C-Cs.

lines.text: Dysprosium and terbium: magnets that survive high heat, in motors.
lines.say: Dysprosium and terbium: magnets that survive high heat, in motors.

visual.label: US-BOUND ONLY
note: PAUSE ON CHINA'S BAN TO THE US ENDS

lines.text: Second date: November 27. China's pause on its gallium, germanium and antimony ban for the US ends.
lines.say: Second date: November twenty-seventh. China's pause on its gallium, germanium and antimony ban for the U.S. ends.

visual.source: SEKO LOGISTICS · EPIC SOURCING · CNY 2027 = 6 FEB

lines.text: Now the trap: factories close one to three weeks around Chinese New Year, February 6.
lines.say: Now the trap. Factories close one to three weeks around Chinese New Year, February sixth.

lines.text: That's why experienced importers place their last pre-holiday orders in early November.
lines.say: That's why experienced importers place their last pre-holiday orders in early November.

items.head: Pre-holiday orders:
items.sub: plan them now, place them by early November.

items.head: Ask your supplier:
items.sub: does any material need a Chinese export license?

lines.text: Plan your pre-holiday orders now. Place them by early November.
lines.say: Plan your pre-holiday orders now. Place them by early November.

lines.say: Ask your suppliers if any material needs a Chinese export license.

lines.text: And if you ship to the US, watch November 27.
lines.say: And if you ship to the U.S., watch November twenty-seventh.

lines.text: What happens on January 10? Nobody knows yet.
lines.say: What happens on January tenth? Nobody knows, yet.

lines.say: Watch APEC in Shenzhen, November eighteenth and nineteenth.
